class Field {
  private storage: string | number = 0;
  get value(): string | number { return this.storage; }
  set value(input: string | number | boolean) {
    if (typeof input !== 'boolean') this.storage = input;
  }
}
const field = new Field();
field.value = 1;
const numeric: number = field.value;
field['value'] = 'text';
const text: string = field.value;
field.value = true;
const broad: string | number = field.value;
let stored: string | number = 0;
const object = { get value(): string | number { return stored; }, set value(input: string | number) { stored = input; } };
object.value = 2;
const objectValue: number = object.value;
class Internal {
  get #value(): string | number { return 3; }
  set #value(input: string | number) {}
  run() {
    this.#value = 3;
    const inside: number = this.#value;
    return inside;
  }
}
console.log(numeric, text, broad, objectValue, new Internal().run());
